summary_markdown: The conversation focused on clarifying the methodology for calculating session frequency, particularly regarding coefficients and base rates. It was confirmed that the default factor is not dependent on the number of days. The 'default' factor represents the ratio of the count of sessions per vendor sample to the count of devices within that same sample (frequencyBase). This rate serves as a baseline or 'natural' frequency before applying any advanced formulas. Specific SQL links were provided for checking how this calculation is performed in the codebase.
decisions: The default factor used for session frequency is based on the ratio of sessions to devices per vendor sample.
action_items: Someone needs to document their understanding of the session frequency calculation and send it to [me] for approval.
